description: What the adapter suite must notice about Gemini token usage: the thinking tokens are left out of the output (they are billed as output), a missing thinking count turns the output unknown, a missing candidates count is taken for zero, or one of the two dialects stops using the shared reading.

mutations.name: G1
mutations.what: the thinking tokens are not part of the output

mutations.name: G2
mutations.what: an answer that reports no thinking tokens has an unknown output

mutations.name: G3
mutations.what: a candidates count the answer does not report is taken for zero

mutations.name: G4
mutations.what: the native dialect reads the usage on its own and leaves the thinking tokens out

patches.new: usage: { input_tokens: reportedTokenCount(result.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount), output_tokens: reportedTokenCount(result.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount), cache_read_tokens: null, reasoning_tokens: null } };

mutations.name: G5
mutations.what: the text-only dialect reports no usage
